title: Preference Pair
description: DPO training record. One pair = one prompt + one picked response + one or more rejected responses. Matches the output shape of `gad feedback record` (shipped 2026-05-09). Human-validated pairs are worth 5-10x model-judged pairs — track the signal in human_validated.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the preference was recorded.

projectid.description: gad project scope. Allows per-project DPO fine-tuning.

turn_id.description: Turn identifier from the originating session, for trace linkage.

question.description: The prompt or user message the responses answer. Full text.

label.description: Display label shown to the human rater. Example: 'Response A'.

index.description: Zero-indexed position in the original candidate list.

preview.description: First 200 chars of the response for quick audit.

response_text.description: Full response text. Include when dataset_block.row_count < 10k; omit and link by turn_id for large datasets.

rejected.description: All non-preferred responses. One or more.

reason.description: Free-text rationale from the human rater. High-value signal for curriculum design.

fragment_content.description: The specific sub-fragment that drove the preference decision, if identified.

model_at_capture.description: Model that generated the candidates. Example: 'claude-sonnet-4-6'.

human_validated.description: True = a human made this preference choice. False = model-judged (automated). Human-validated rows weigh more in DPO training.

score_signal.description: Optional continuous reward signal [0, 1] if the rater provided a numeric score alongside the binary pick.

examples.question: Stamp GLOBAL-T-173-20 as done with agent claude-code and runtime claude-code.

picked.label: Response A
picked.preview: gad tasks stamp GLOBAL-T-173-20 --projectid global --status done
picked.response_text: gad tasks stamp GLOBAL-T-173-20 --projectid global --status done --agent claude-code --runtime claude-code --skill frontend-design

rejected.label: Response B
rejected.response_text: I'll stamp that task for you now.

examples.reason: Response B is narration, not the required CLI invocation.
